question: The second five-year plan of India focused on ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**rapid industrialization.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The second five-year plan's main focus was on the **rapid industrial development** of the country.
 
• It was made from **1956 to 1961**, under the leadership of Jawaharlal Nehru.
 
• The Second Five Year Plan was based on **Mahalanobis Model**.
 
• P. C. Mahalanobis was a famous Indian statistician who **founded** the **Indian Statistical Institute.**
 
• This plan lags behind its target growth rate of 4.5% and achieved a growth rate of 4.27%.
